_about: Hand-maintained rules for /fedramp-lookup/. Each listing is assigned one case by scripts/fedramp/build_lookup.py; each case answers every row. Edit the wording here and push to rebuild. Every case must answer every row, or the build fails. States: lev = package can be leveraged, dec = agency risk decision, no = not recognized, wait = not yet available. {status} in a note is replaced with the listing's marketplace status.
